declaration.guide:
<declaration>
RULE: state a declaration envelope for every turn as a single JSON object. **Write it FIRST, before any tool call** — text placed after a tool call is discarded by the server and does not count. In done_report, `tool` MUST be the exact name of the tool that performed what you claim; if no tool performed it, use null.
{"turn_type":"ACT|ASK|CONFIRM|INFORM|DONE","next_action":"<tool you are calling now or null>","ask":{"slot":"<slot>","reason":"missing|confirm"} or null,"done_report":[{"kind":"<claim kind>","what":"<what you did>","tool":"<exact tool name or null>","resolves":null}],"prose":"<what you tell the customer>"}
The declaration must match what you actually do this turn.
</declaration>

_note: ★도메인-불변 A2(base). 3도메인이 **그대로** 쓰는 내용만 둔다 ⇒ 새 도메인 추가 시 **opex 0**. 로더(`gate_interpreter.load_domain_a2`)가 domain 파일과 병합하며 **도메인 값이 우선**한다. 감사=`x17_a2_layer_audit.py`. 여기 있는 것은 도구명·업종 명사 0이어야 한다(그렇지 않으면 domain 파일로 내려야 함).
_note_declaration: W-A(2026-07-31·arm③): 선언-우선 봉투. **내용이 도메인-불변**이라 A2 3층의 **CORE**(도메인-불변 기본 스킬 세팅)에 속한다 — 다른 도메인에 그대로 복사되므로 **도메인-특화 opex 0**. 도구명·업종 명사 0. 가이드의 '호출 앞에 쓸 것'은 C248(파서가 호출 뒤 텍스트를 버림) 때문이고, done_report.tool 필수는 R5를 **닫힌 술어**로 만들기 위함이다.

claim_audit.question: Before your reply is sent, audit yourself. (1) In YOUR REPLY ONLY: list every assertion that YOU (the agent/system) have ALREADY performed some action in this conversation — e.g. searched or checked the knowledge base or records, verified something, filed/submitted/updated/logged something, given the customer a tool, or transferred them. Statements about what the CUSTOMER did do NOT count. (2) Across the WHOLE conversation: list every action YOU said you WILL do / are about to do (e.g. 'I will file the disputes') that you have NOT completed yet. Reply with exactly one JSON object and nothing else: {"claims": [{"kind": "{kinds}", "what": "<5-10 words>"}], "pending": [{"kind": "{kinds}", "what": "<5-10 words>", "tool": "<the exact tool name you would need to call for it, or omit if none>"}]} — empty lists if none. Choose the MOST SPECIFIC kind that fits {kind_guidance}; use the generic "write" ONLY when no specific kind applies.
claim_audit.feedback: Error: [CLAIM-PROVENANCE] your reply asserts you already did the following, but the conversation ledger shows NO such event: {claims}. Do NOT claim actions you have not actually performed — that misleads the customer. Either actually do it now (call the real tools: search the knowledge base, run the verification, execute the action), or correct your statement to say you have not done it yet. A statement to the customer is NOT a substitute for the tool call: if the action is still required, make the call in THIS reply; if you cannot make it (for example it is the customer who must run that tool), say plainly that it has NOT been done and tell them exactly what remains.
claim_audit.feedback_pending: Error: [CLAIM-PROVENANCE] earlier in this conversation you told the customer you WOULD do the following, but the conversation ledger shows it was never actually executed: {claims}. You are about to end your involvement (resign or transfer) with these promises unfulfilled — that abandons the customer's request. Do the promised work NOW by calling the real tools, and only transfer or end the conversation after the actions are actually executed (or explicitly tell the customer you could not do them and why). Do not end your involvement by describing the work as done or under way — either call the tool now, or state explicitly that it has NOT been performed.
claim_audit.feedback_unavailable: Error: [UNAVAILABLE-CAPABILITY] you told the customer you would do the following, but the tool it requires does not exist among the tools available to you: {claims}. Do not offer or promise capabilities you do not have — it strands the customer waiting for something that will never happen. Say plainly that you cannot do it, and either use a capability you actually have or follow the escalation path in your policy.
claim_audit.completion_question: Before your reply is sent, answer ONE question about YOUR REPLY ONLY. Does your reply state or imply that some action has already been completed, submitted, filed, scheduled, or confirmed — OR that YOU (the agent) will submit/schedule/perform it? Merely giving the customer a tool to run, or instructing THEM to run it, does NOT count. Reply with exactly one JSON object and nothing else: {"claims_completion": true} or {"claims_completion": false}
claim_audit.completion_feedback: Error: [WRITE-PROVENANCE] your reply claims an action was completed/submitted/scheduled, but there is no record of any state-changing action having executed in this conversation. You cannot perform actions the customer must run themselves; only the CUSTOMER can, by calling the tool you gave them. Do NOT claim any action has been submitted, filed, or scheduled; do NOT invent case/reference/confirmation numbers; do NOT promise callbacks or confirmation emails. Instead, restate your reply: hand the customer the appropriate tool and tell them to run it themselves.

_note_claim_audit: L1(2026-07-31·C254 감사 후속·정본=CLAIM_AUDIT_ENGINE_PROMOTION_DESIGN_2026_07_31.md): 완료-주장을 실행 원장과 대조하는 **도메인-일반 무결성 원리**의 산문. 업종 명사 0 — 유일한 도메인 접점이던 kind enum은 `{kinds}` 자리표시자로 뽑아 L2가 채운다. 로더가 L1+L2를 합성해 구 `claim_prov`/`completion_guard`와 **바이트 동일**한 dict를 만든다(등가 게이트=test_claim_promotion). [[23]] 출처: 정책 근거 없음이 확인됐고(정책 7항은 내부정보 유출 금지) gold 경유도 아니다 — banking 사실이 아니라 원리이므로 L1이 옳은 자리다. ★2차 교정(같은 날): 산문에 **kind 용어집**("record_update for changing…, dispute_file for filing…")이 박혀 있어 도메인-불변이 아니었다 — 등가 테스트 §③이 잡았다. `{kind_guidance}`로 뽑아 L2가 채운다.
